# Color Tokens

## Color Tokens

Semantic colors for consistent theming. All colors use light-dark() for automatic mode switching.

Status roles: pick the token by the surface. `<status>` is info, success, warning, or error.

Status role               | Use it for                                                                                      | Pairs with               
------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------
--color-text-<status>     | Status text on the page or a card (4.5:1 or more).                                              | —                        
--color-icon-<status>     | Status icons and marks on the page or a card, such as a StatusDot. Defaults to the text colour. | —                        
--color-border-<status>   | Status borders on the page or a card, such as an invalid field. Defaults to the text colour.    | —                        
--color-<status>          | Strong status fill, such as a Badge.                                                            | --color-on-<status>      
--color-on-<status>       | Text and icons on the strong fill (4.5:1 or more).                                              | --color-<status>         
--color-<status>-muted    | Pale status fill, such as a Banner.                                                             | --color-on-<status>-muted
--color-on-<status>-muted | Text and icons on the pale fill (4.5:1 or more).                                                | --color-<status>-muted
